description:
Mondoir.art is a platform for discovering, collecting, and understanding contemporary art. It connects collectors, galleries, and artists through a structured ecosystem that combines traditional art practices with AI-assisted insights and modern documentation tools.

Through the Mondoir.art app, users can explore curated artworks, learn about artists and collections, and access contextual information about artworks, valuation, provenance, and editions. The platform is designed to make the art world easier to navigate by organizing information that is often fragmented across galleries, marketplaces, and social platforms.

Collectors can use the app to research artworks, track editions, and explore how contemporary art is presented and documented. Artists and galleries can present their work in a structured environment that supports discovery and documentation.

By integrating with ChatGPT, the Mondoir.art app allows users to ask questions about artists, artworks, exhibitions, and collecting — turning complex art information into clear and accessible conversations.
